name: app_spec
title: Spec an App
description: A per-app specification pipeline for portfolio child projects. Runs the product, design, technical, planning, and review phases for one selected app concept without generating code.

phases.title: Prompt Contract
phases.purpose: Preserve the user's original prompt and convert it into a clear spec contract for this one selected app: requirements, non-goals, success metrics, production expectations, and decision rules.

phases.title: Product Research
phases.purpose: For this one app concept, infer the likely market, audience, competitors/patterns, platform expectations, risks, and native iOS opportunities. Label assumptions clearly and turn the research into implications for this app's v1.

phases.title: Portfolio Selection
phases.purpose: Confirm this spec is a single portfolio child and not a parent wrapper. Record the parent category/selection rationale and why this child should stay as its own app.

phases.title: Initial Discussion
phases.purpose: For this one app concept, establish a precise understanding of what it is, who it is for, the core problem it solves, hard scope boundaries, and measurable success criteria.

phases.title: Per App Product Brief
phases.purpose: Create a production-grade product brief for this specific app: paid value, core loop, competitive wedge, local-first behavior, cloud-ready path, growth angle, and why the app deserves to exist.

phases.title: Next Steps Small
phases.purpose: Define this app's smallest valuable local-first slice / immediate next steps that de-risk and validate the concept with minimal effort.

phases.title: Detailed Discussion
phases.purpose: Deeply analyze this app's requirements, edge cases, constraints, assumptions, risks, and open questions, resolving ambiguity left from earlier phases.

phases.title: App Features
phases.purpose: Enumerate and prioritize this app's feature set with explicit in-scope vs out-of-scope lines.

phases.title: Design Discussion
phases.purpose: Decide this app's UX flows, information architecture, key screens/states, design direction, and Claude Design handoff requirements.

phases.title: Design Handoff
phases.purpose: Produce a complete design handoff and Claude Design prompt/import plan: screens, states, tokens, motion notes, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

phases.title: Ios Architecture Review
phases.purpose: Review the spec as an iOS product: SwiftUI architecture, local persistence, Apple frameworks, privacy, permissions, permissive dependencies, StoreKit when relevant, and testability.

phases.title: Tech Specs
phases.purpose: Decide this app's architecture, technology stack, data model, interfaces/APIs, and non-functional requirements with justified trade-offs. This is a spec-only project, so do not emit build tasks.

phases.title: Project Plan
phases.purpose: Produce this app's milestones, sequencing, estimates, dependencies, risks, and a future implementation plan.

phases.title: Implementation Readiness Gate
phases.purpose: Audit whether the spec is coherent enough for a future one-shot build. Resolve contradictions, downgrade impossible scope, and name any information the builder must still collect.

phases.title: Human Qa Checklist
phases.purpose: Draft the manual QA script that a future build must satisfy for every important workflow, state, persistence case, and accessibility check.

phases.title: App Store Readiness
phases.purpose: Prepare launch-readiness material for a future build: positioning, screenshots, privacy labels, subscription/paywall risks, support needs, and likely review blockers.

phases.title: Final Review
phases.purpose: Final review of this app specification's completeness, consistency, risks, and go / no-go recommendation for a future build.

phases.title: Portfolio Audit
phases.purpose: Confirm this spec child preserves the parent portfolio requirements and has the right sibling-folder/workflow metadata for later Jira/Notion backfill.
